newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan offshore banking unit assets rise in May.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan offshore banking unit assets rise in May.

text.p: The combined assets of Taiwan's 69 offshore banking units (OBU) grew 15.87 percent to hit a new high of US$39.596 billion at the end of May from a year earlier, the central bank said on Thursday.
About 76 percent of the assets, held by 37 local banks and 32 foreign banks, came from Asia and the rest from Europe and America, the bank said.
It said it had recently approved one more OBU application for a foreign bank and one more for a local bank.
In May, Taiwan's OBUs reported a monthly foreign exchange turnover of $4.088 billion.
